title: A reversal preserves its relationship to the original movement
question: Posting direction/order and original evidence need explicit semantics; the observed mechanism is not accepted accounting scope.

evidence.title: Reversal swaps posting direction and reverses posting order
explanation: The posting helper creates a new posting slice, swaps each source/destination and reverses its order while preserving asset and amount. Transaction.Reverse builds a new transaction from those postings instead of negating unsigned posting amounts or rewriting the original transaction in this helper.

Constructing inverse postings is not persisted reversal. Original-event linkage, one-time eligibility, authorization and committed history were not established. Amount pointers are shallow-copied, so deep ownership is not proven.
